articles.title: Global Market: French bond yields hold steady despite Fitch downgrade warning
articles.desc: French bond yields remained steady despite Fitch downgrading the country's outlook to negative, as investors weighed fiscal concerns and political uncertainty against easing energy prices and developments in the Middle East.

articles.title: Oyo parent PRISM clocks PAT of Rs 353 crore in Q1, up 17% YoY, revenue jumps 35%
articles.desc: Oyo parent PRISM reported a 35% YoY rise in Q1FY27 revenue to Rs 2,814 crore, while net profit grew 17% to Rs 353 crore. Gross Booking Value increased 30% to Rs 9,600 crore and EBITDA rose 24% to Rs 760 crore. Founder Ritesh Agarwal highlighted growth across hotels and vacation homes, technology investments and AI-led operational efficiencies.

articles.title: India’s manufacturing output dominated by large factories, while smaller units lag behind
articles.desc: India's manufacturing sector is highly fragmented, with large factories significantly outpacing small units in productivity and output. While large establishments employ most industrial workers and generate high GVA, smaller units remain burdened with debt. The productivity gap is exacerbated by limited access to technology and training for smaller factories. Additionally, women workers constitute a small fraction of the overall workforce in manufacturing.

articles.title: Japan bond yields edge higher ahead of key JGB auctions; 10-year yield holds at 2.77%
articles.desc: Japanese government bond yields were mixed on Monday, with the 10-year benchmark holding steady at 2.77%, while the 20-year and 30-year yields rose. Investors assessed global interest rate trends ahead of a series of government debt auctions, including a 10-year bond sale on Thursday, followed by 30-year and five-year auctions later this month.

articles.title: Indian IPO market clocks record Rs 84,400 crore in H1 FY27, fundraising jumps 30%
articles.desc: India's mainboard IPO market raised a record Rs 84,400 crore in H1 FY27, up 30% year-on-year, as September saw unprecedented fundraising. Strong investor participation, confidential filings and a robust pipeline supported primary market momentum.

articles.title: FIIs increase stake: 11 Nifty stocks rally up to 50% in FY27 so far
articles.desc: Foreign institutional investors raised their stakes in 19 Nifty 50 companies in the September 2026 quarter. Of these, 11 stocks have gained 10% to 50% in FY27 so far, reflecting strong price momentum alongside increased FII ownership.

articles.title: MobiKwik shares zoom 10% as fintech firm posts record Rs 12 crore profit in Q2
articles.desc: MobiKwik returned to profitability in Q2 FY27, reporting a record consolidated net profit of Rs 11.8 crore against a loss of Rs 28.6 crore a year earlier. Profit rose over 55% sequentially from Rs 7.6 crore in Q1 FY27, while revenue from operations increased 9% year-on-year to Rs 1,082.6 crore.

articles.title: Anthrax outbreak kills hippos in DR Congo’s Virunga National Park
articles.desc: Drought and conflict compound the threat to wildlife in eastern DR Congo.

articles.title: How are equity investments taxed in India? A guide to capital gains tax
articles.desc: In a bid to invigorate domestic and foreign mutual fund investments, India's Securities and Exchange Board has put forth recommendations for tax concessions. These proposals are designed to boost post-tax returns, particularly as market performance has been behind that of emerging counterparts. The current capital gains tax rates are seen as a hindrance, leading to demands for a review.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs expects Bank of England to raise rates again in February
articles.desc: Goldman Sachs has revised its outlook on the Bank of England's interest rates, now predicting a possible quarter-point rise in November's monetary policy meeting. This would be the first increase since 2023, influenced by climbing energy costs and robust economic growth. Although immediate policy shifts are unlikely, the Bank will vigilantly observe inflation risks, maintaining rates at 4.25% through mid-next year.

articles.title: Trump set for midterm test: What's in store for India, Iran, Ukraine after November 4?
articles.desc: US midterm election 2026: American voters' sentiments about rising prices could affect Trump's standing in trade discussions. Congressional control will determine the scrutiny over Trump's actions regarding Iran and Ukraine. India will, however, continue navigating uncertainties in trade relations regardless of the election results.

articles.title: Missed Reliance Industries’ historic 12% one-day rally? Here’s what technical analysts are saying
articles.desc: Reliance Industries experienced a remarkable increase in share price after reporting impressive Q2 earnings, which significantly boosted its market capitalization. The firm’s net profit surged by 41% year-over-year, fueled by strong performances in its oil-to-chemicals and digital services segments. Analysts express optimism, with several brokerages setting ambitious target prices. Current technical indicators also reveal a favorable price trajectory, suggesting room for further growth following this positive oil sector performance.

articles.title: South Eastern Coalfields files DRHP with SEBI for IPO; Coal India to offload 66.8 crore shares
articles.desc: Coal India subsidiary South Eastern Coalfields has filed its draft papers with SEBI for an IPO comprising an offer for sale of up to 66.81 crore shares. One of India’s largest coal producers, SECL reported higher revenue and profit and plans to list on the BSE and NSE.

articles.title: Anthropic plans to sell $3.5 billion of shares to Japan investors in IPO, filing shows
articles.desc: The new shares issued to Japanese investors will go to raise working capital and fund operating expenses and capital expenditure, the filing said.

articles.title: Office, retail and warehousing offer new opportunities as India’s real estate market matures: JLL
articles.desc: India’s commercial real estate market is entering a new phase, with office, retail and warehousing offering fresh opportunities for institutional investors, a JLL report said. Despite cap rates hitting historic lows, the sector continues to offer double-digit unlevered returns over five years. With limited scope for further compression, future returns will increasingly depend on rental income growth and operational efficiencies.

articles.title: Bitcoin rattled by biggest crypto heist in history! Why Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger hated cryptocurrency
articles.desc: A reported $6 billion crypto heist at Binance has rattled investors and revived concerns about cryptocurrency risks. Binance said its initial investigation pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop, which may have enabled unauthorised withdrawals. The FBI blamed North Korea for the attack, while Binance said it would cover the losses.

articles.title: Big tech share buybacks plunge 83% as AI spending hits cash flows
articles.desc: Major US technology companies sharply reduced dividends and share buybacks as record AI infrastructure spending pushed their combined free cash flow into deficit. The shift raises concerns about shareholder returns and places greater pressure on Big Tech to deliver profit growth from its AI investments.

articles.title: Explained: Why gold investors should tone down expectations as yellow metal plunges to a 1-year low
articles.desc: Gold has fallen more than 30% from its January record high, with rising oil prices, inflation concerns and expectations of further Fed rate hikes adding to pressure. Analysts remain cautious about a near-term recovery, even as major banks retain bullish forecasts for 2027.

articles.title: Nasdaq Outlook: Is the worst over for AI-fuelled tech stocks?
articles.desc: Wall Street’s AI-led rally faced a sharp setback as the Nasdaq recorded its biggest single-day fall since June. Heavy losses in technology stocks reflected growing investor concerns over hyperscaler spending and the returns on artificial intelligence investments.

articles.title: Hormuz shipping still faces major risks

articles.title: Pizza Hut, KFC India operator's Q2 loss naarrows sharply on strong same-store sales growth
articles.desc: Devyani International, the parent company of KFC and Pizza Hut in India, has recorded a significant reduction in losses during its second quarter. With revenues climbing by 10.4% to 15.19 billion rupees and expenses only rising 8.3%, Chairman Ravi Jaipuria emphasized the ongoing challenges posed by inflation and increasing interest rates.

articles.title: Dixon Technologies shares gain 11% after Q2 revenue jumps 47% YoY

EBITDA margin contracted to 3.1% from 7.1% a year ago, despite higher revenue and operating profit growth.

articles.title: India, EU discuss FTA implementation ahead of December signing
articles.desc: In an effort to advance their free trade agreement, India and the European Union held pivotal discussions led by Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal, who visited Brussels for dialogues with prominent EU officials. Central to the talks were customs cooperation and trade facilitation, deemed critical for the agreement's efficacy. Additionally, industry stakeholders from the diamond sector were engaged to harness opportunities within India's expanding market.

articles.title: Bangladesh garment factories disrupted as protests continue for third day
articles.desc: Workers in Bangladesh's largest export sector are demanding a minimum wage increase amid rising inflation.

articles.title: India, EU discuss FTA implementation, customs cooperation and market access in Brussels
articles.desc: India and the European Union engaged in discussions regarding the implementation of their Free Trade Agreement. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal held meetings with various senior European Commission officials in Brussels, focusing on market access and customs procedures. The FTA is expected to eliminate tariffs on the majority of exports from both regions. Both parties are working towards the proposed signing and full ratification of the agreement.

articles.title: Sebi backs removal of LTCG tax for foreign investors: Report
articles.desc: To boost foreign investment interest, India's Securities and Exchange Board has put forth a proposal to scrap long-term capital gains tax for foreign investors and extend tax relief to mutual fund investors. The falling crude prices are expected to alleviate inflation concerns and fiscal pressures for India. Furthermore, the Reserve Bank of India may adjust its interest rate plans based on these developments.

articles.desc: South Korean shares rose after early losses due to strong export data that improved investor sentiment. Exports from South Korea nearly doubled in October, marking their highest increase in over 50 years. Analysts indicated that this performance might lead to upward revisions in corporate earnings forecasts. However, factory activity in South Korea expanded at its slowest pace in eight months.

articles.desc: Reliance Industries shares surged nearly 12% after reporting outstanding Q2 results for FY27. The company announced a massive 41% yearly increase in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore, alongside a 29% rise in revenue to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. Many international brokers are holding onto 'Buy' ratings, anticipating considerable upside for the stock. These recent gains have helped Reliance rebound from a 52-week low recorded earlier this month.

articles.title: US midterm elections begin tomorrow: Can Trump’s likely defeat sparkle Sensex, Nifty? Here’s what analysts say
articles.desc: The November 3 US midterm elections could reshape control of Congress, with analysts anticipating potential Republican losses. A divided government may heighten market volatility, although historical annualised returns remain largely unaffected. For Indian investors, the key concerns are the dollar, US bond yields, crude oil prices and foreign fund flows amid an already challenging market environment.

articles.title: Cheap stocks aren’t enough: The one trigger FIIs need to return to India
articles.desc: FIIs have pulled nearly $64 billion from Indian equities over the past two years, marking the longest and deepest sell-off in two decades, according to JM Financial. Despite cheaper valuations and an improving earnings outlook, foreign investors remain on the sidelines, with a sustained decline in crude oil prices emerging as a key trigger for their return.

articles.title: Wall Street rushes in with bullish calls on India’s top bourse
articles.desc: Wall Street brokerages are turning bullish on NSE, citing its dominant market position and India’s expanding capital markets. Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan and 360 ONE recommend buying the stock, projecting up to 30% upside. Rising investor participation, trading activity and new businesses could drive long-term revenue and earnings growth.

articles.title: Diwali stocks to buy! 8 stocks with upside potential of up to 52%
articles.desc: As Diwali approaches, Axis Direct has spotlighted nine stocks with significant upside potential for savvy investors. Among these, ITC Ltd. is projected to soar with a 39% target price hike, while Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders could see an impressive 68% rise. Olectra Greentech joins the ranks with a forecasted increase of 52%. Coforge and Hindalco also make the list, suggesting a strategic investment opportunity this festive season.

articles.title: Gold price prediction today: Gold down for 3rd consecutive day. Check outlook for November 2
articles.desc: Gold and silver prices experienced mixed movements on MCX ahead of Diwali due to inflation fears. Rising inflation triggered expectations for a potential US Federal Reserve interest rate hike later this year. Federal Reserve officials have suggested further interest rate increases are needed to address inflation. Silver futures gained while gold futures saw a decline in the domestic market.

articles.title: Rupee falls 21 paise to 94.97 against US dollar in early trade
articles.desc: In the early hours of trading, the rupee fell by 21 paise to 94.97 against the US dollar, influenced by a firmer dollar along with local market dynamics. Although Brent crude prices decreased, which offered some support, the Reserve Bank of India’s interventions helped stabilize volatility. Meanwhile, foreign institutional investors actively purchased equities, contributing to notable rises in both the Sensex and Nifty indices.

articles.title: Apple's new CEO John Ternus to face first earnings test as memory costs surge
articles.desc: Ternus, who took the reins from Tim Cook in September, has overseen the introduction of Apple's first foldable phone, smart home hub and Apple's first touch-screen laptops. All of those products began shipping during the company's current fiscal first quarter, amid what Cook had called a "100-year flood" of rising memory costs.

articles.title: This auto ancillary stock soars 13% after Q2 PAT jumps 35% YoY. Do you own it?
articles.desc: Motherson Sumi Wiring shares surged after the auto ancillary company reported a 35% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit and 47% revenue growth. Premiumisation, higher content per vehicle and new model wins supported the performance.

articles.title: Zen Technologies shares rally 9% after Q2 profit rises 51% YoY, revenue nearly doubles
articles.desc: Zen Technologies shares jumped 8.67% after the defence technology company reported a 51% YoY rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 90 crore, while revenue surged 98% to Rs 345 crore. The company recorded an order inflow of Rs 481.81 crore during the quarter, taking its consolidated order book to Rs 1,375.70 crore as of September 30, 2026.

articles.title: 5 key global market themes investors will watch this week
articles.desc: Global markets brace for a crucial week featuring US midterm elections, jobs data, major AI-linked earnings and central bank decisions, alongside economic developments in Brazil, Indonesia and Europe that could drive volatility.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs raises oil price forecasts, warns Brent could hit $140 in 2027
articles.desc: Goldman Sachs raised its oil price forecasts amid mounting geopolitical risks and potential Gulf supply disruptions. The bank warned Brent crude could reach $140 per barrel in 2027 under a prolonged supply shock scenario. Shipping attacks, infrastructure damage and Middle East tensions could sustain elevated oil prices and market volatility.

articles.title: Tech picks: HCL Tech, Saregama among 5 stocks to buy for up to 11% returns in short term
articles.desc: Market analysts suggest that savvy investors should keep an eye on stock picks aimed at generating robust short-term returns. HCL Tech and Samavardhana Motherson are flagged for their potential upward movement in the recovering economy. Conversely, Dixon has been marked for sale due to a downturn in performance. Additionally, Saregama and TVS Motor Company are anticipated to show promising results shortly, influenced by recent technical insights and market trends.

articles.title: Diwali 2026: 77 stocks knock down D-St bears to deliver multibagger returns of up to 4,700% in a year
articles.desc: With Diwali 2026 on the horizon, 77 stocks have thrived despite market fluctuations, marking exceptional returns. Mrugesh Trading showcases an astonishing gain of 4,657%, while Axis Solution follows closely with 1,081%. Other strong performers are Sterlite Technologies and Cupid, each demonstrating impressive growth. Analysts are hopeful for a market rebound thanks to falling crude oil prices, which could positively impact sectors such as automotive, capital goods, and pharmaceuticals.

articles.title: Yuan hovers near four-year high as investors eye US midterm elections
articles.desc: China’s yuan traded near a more than four-year high against the US dollar, supported by expectations of further appreciation. Investors tracked the central bank’s currency guidance, policy measures and potential market implications of the US midterm elections.

articles.title: FII retreat deepens: Almost every second Nifty stock sees stake cuts in all 3 quarters of 2026
articles.desc: This year has seen Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) divest nearly ₹3 lakh crore in Indian equities, causing a significant reduction in their stakes. As a result, FII ownership has declined in about half of the Nifty stocks over the past three quarters. Meanwhile, Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) have increased their equity holdings, reflecting a change in market dynamics amidst frequent foreign sell-offs.

articles.title: Why did market rally today? Sensex soars 1,233 pts, Nifty ends above 23,400. 7 factors behind Rs 8 lakh crore gains
articles.desc: On Monday, a remarkable surge in the Indian stock market was observed, with the Sensex soaring by 1,233 points. This uplift was driven by plummeting oil prices and robust earnings reports from key players like Reliance Industries. The return of foreign institutional investors as net buyers after a recent retreat, along with the anticipation of potential relief in long-term capital gains tax, spurred a wave of optimism.

articles.title: Tesla, Samsung oppose new US tariffs on Vietnam as probe deadline nears
articles.desc: Businesses are divided over whether Washington should propose new tariffs on Vietnamese goods this month, with Tesla and Samsung not in favour, while others have called for penalties, submissions to the US government show.

articles.title: China’s 5,000-ton digging machines are a trade war risk to India
articles.desc: China is tightening export controls on tunnel-boring machines and other specialised construction equipment, raising concerns that the restrictions could disrupt India's infrastructure projects, particularly along the disputed Himalayan border.

articles.title: AI debt surge pushes Magnificent Seven borrowing to $578 billion, up 45%: SBI Research

articles.title: China's robot makers have mastered the moves. Now comes the race for brains
articles.desc: The shift is fuelling an investment boom in embodied AI, a field focused on software that allows robots to understand their surroundings, learn unfamiliar tasks and adapt without having to be programmed for every job.

articles.title: South Korea's Lee vows to make bold AI investment in record budget push
articles.desc: His administration proposed in September increasing government spending by a record 12.8% next year to 820.9 trillion won ($615.62 billion) aiming to strengthen South Korea's technological edge as global competition over AI intensifies.

articles.title: Binance sees outflows stabilising as exchange returns online after $6.3 billion heist

articles.title: India likely to meet FY27 fiscal deficit target despite spending pressures: Goldman Sachs
articles.desc: The Centre appears on track to meet the fiscal deficit target set for FY27. Strong corporate tax collections are offsetting some revenue pressures observed in the first half of the fiscal year. Focused expenditure reallocation will be crucial in achieving the deficit goals.

Strong consumption trends are indicated by rising passenger car sales and record digital payments. Analysts suggest this growth aligns with leading indicators of a consumption-driven economy.

articles.title: One nation, many opportunities: Why India's many elections may be keeping protests peaceful
articles.desc: People across India are protesting peacefully, contrasting with violent agitations seen in other countries. The 'one nation, multiple elections' framework allows diverse political benefits to be shared among parties. This electoral model keeps governments accountable and responsive to public needs. Elections help to channel frustrations and enable citizens to express their concerns. As a result, the political landscape remains dynamic and participatory, fostering a sense of empowerment.

articles.title: PM Modi to meet Niti Aayog leadership on Nov 5; likely to  review  work as govt begins shaping  FY28 Budget
articles.desc: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to meet the new leadership of Niti Aayog on November 5. This meeting aims to establish budget priorities amidst global uncertainty and economic growth challenges. The focus will be on enhancing domestic manufacturing and creating employment opportunities. Experts from various sectors will provide insights related to India's development objectives.

articles.title: CII calls for GST-like reforms in land, labour & local approvals

articles.title: Sebi to delist penny stocks: Market regulator plans AI-based surveillance of such firms
articles.desc: The Securities and Exchange Board of India plans to delist companies that have no economic activity. This move aims to protect investors, especially those investing in penny stocks. The regulator highlights the potential dangers posed by such inactive companies in the market. Additionally, Sebi intends to announce compliance requirements for foreign institutional investors soon.

articles.title: Mansukh Mandaviya rolls out EPFO services on WhatsApp, starts auto-settlement of small inoperative accounts
articles.desc: Union Labour & Employment Minister Mansukh Mandaviya launched EPFO services through WhatsApp for easier access. Subscribers can check their PF balance and transaction history conveniently using this platform. The automatic settlement for inoperative EPF accounts was also introduced, streamlining the process for beneficiaries. In total, around one lakh accounts will benefit from this initiative. The EPFO's commitment to evolve and focus on worker-centric innovations was emphasized during the celebration.

articles.title: EAM Jaishankar discusses Ukraine-Russia conflict solutions amid G20 summit
articles.desc: India has engaged in discussions with Russia, Europe, and Ukraine regarding the ongoing conflict and its impact. These talks focused on preventing attacks on civilian shipping and restoring grain exports affected by Black Sea disruptions. External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar emphasised the complexity of discussions around ceasing attacks on energy installations. Various interpretations of what constitutes energy installations have complicated these discussions.
